stakeBindingCorrection.finding: The public Botemanía summaries label 0.10-20 EUR and 0.10-10 EUR as 'valor moneda', not as Total Bet bounds.
stakeBindingCorrection.impact: Those ranges cannot be used as execution-grade stake bounds because jackpot probability is explicitly proportional to Total Bet.
stakeBindingCorrection.required: Runtime/paytable binding of exact Total Bet menu before any execution calculation.

criticalArchitectureResult.warning: The 2.32% versus 0.38% current-pot funding ratio is not treated as a trigger-probability ratio. Shared pots plus within-title proportionality do not logically prove identical or funding-proportional absolute hazard coefficients across different game profiles.
criticalArchitectureResult.executionImpact: Fishin' Frenzy Megaways remains P0 research because its current operator page is internally consistent and Total-Bet proportionality is explicit, but execution still needs absolute hazard/lower-bound, exact Total Bet runtime binding, and fresh Royal/Regal state.
